statement: There are constants Ctr < ∞ and Ntr with the following property. Let N ≥ Ntr, let A ⊆ [N] be square-difference-free, and let B ⊆ PN satisfy qB ≤ Nτ . Put S = PN \ B, D = M0qB, N′ = ⌈N/D2 ⌉, λ = D2N′ N . For any s mod M0 and zB ∈ XB, define g = (L[N],PN ,Qfs)(zB, ·). 36 Then 1 ≤ N′ < N, and ZS(g) ≤ λd max A′⊆[N′] A′ square-difference-free Y (N′ , A′ ) + CtrN−σ0 . (7.7) Moreover, for arbitrary choices sv mod M0 and zB,v ∈ XB, one for every v ∈ V , the functions gv = (L[N],PN ,Qfsv )(zB,v, ·) satisfy |ZS((gv)v∈V )| ≤ λd max A′⊆[N′] A′ square-difference-free Y (N′ , A′ ) + CtrN−σ0 . (7.8) All constants are uniform in N, A, B, s, zB and the mixed specifications. Finally, 1 ≤ λ < 1 + D2 N , λd = 1 + Od(D2 /N) = 1 + Od,M0 (N−1+2τ ). (7.9)
